author: Alfred Brehm / Wilhelm Haacke / Eduard Pechuël-Loesche / Richard Schmidtlein (Commons author field); engraving signed by Friedrich Specht (d. 1909); scan: Biodiversity Heritage Library (Flickr upload https://www.flickr.com/photos/biodivlibrary/6220164475)
license: Public domain: Commons tag {{PD-scan|PD-old-70-1923}} (1895 work; engraver died 1909). The Commons page also carries {{CC-BY-2.0}} for the BHL Flickr scan (FlickreviewR pass 2015-08-30); attribution given to the Biodiversity Heritage Library accordingly. Tags read from the file's wikitext and extmetadata, 2026-11-17
used_as: image cue (0:38-1:00): the animal cut out of the engraving (hand-seeded GrabCut), rotated 24 deg and hung by its tail tip from the film's own cord. Re-posed by us: in the original it stands stepping out of grass with its tail curled round a branch. Used from the Commons 1280 px thumbnail of the 2268x3381 original (thumbnail sha1 differs from the original's).
